subclasses.name: Path of the Berserker
subclasses.description: Barbarians who walk the Path of the Berserker direct their Rage primarily toward violence. Their path is one of untrammeled fury, and they thrill in the chaos of battle.

features.name: Frenzy
features.description: If you use Reckless Attack while Raging, deal extra damage to the first target you hit on your turn with a Strength-based attack. Roll d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus.

features.name: Mindless Rage
features.description: You are immune to the Charmed and Frightened conditions while Raging. If you are already affected by them when you enter Rage, the condition ends.

features.name: Retaliation
features.description: When you take damage from a creature within 5ft, use a Reaction to make one melee attack against them.

features.name: Intimidating Presence
features.description: As a Bonus Action, force each chosen creature in a 30ft Emanation to make a Wisdom save or be Frightened for 1 minute (repeat save at end of turns). Can restore use by expending one Rage.

subclasses.name: Path of the Wild Heart
subclasses.description: Barbarians who follow the Path of the Wild Heart view themselves as kin to animals, gaining supernatural might and primal connections to the natural world.

features.name: Animal Speaker
features.description: Cast Beast Sense and Speak with Animals as Rituals (Wisdom based).

features.name: Rage of the Wilds
features.description: Choose an animal spirit benefit whenever you activate your Rage:

options.name: Bear
options.description: Resistance to every damage type except Force, Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant.

options.name: Eagle
options.description: Take Dash and Disengage as part of the Bonus Action to enter Rage. While Raging, use a Bonus Action to take both.

options.name: Wolf
options.description: Allies have Advantage on attack rolls against enemies within 5ft of you.

features.name: Aspect of the Wilds
features.description: Choose one option; change choice after a Long Rest:

options.name: Owl
options.description: Gain 60ft Darkvision (or increase existing Darkvision by 60ft).

options.name: Panther
options.description: Gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.

options.name: Salmon
options.description: Gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Nature Speaker
features.description: Cast Commune with Nature as a Ritual (Wisdom based).

features.name: Power of the Wilds
features.description: Choose a benefit whenever you activate your Rage:

options.name: Falcon
options.description: Gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed if not wearing armor.

options.name: Lion
options.description: Enemies within 5ft have Disadvantage on attack rolls against targets other than you or another Wild Heart Barbarian.

options.name: Ram
options.description: Cause a Large or smaller creature to be Prone when you hit it with a melee attack.

subclasses.name: Path of the World Tree
subclasses.description: Barbarians who follow the Path of the World Tree connect with the cosmic tree Yggdrasil through their Rage, drawing on its magic for vitality and dimensional travel.

features.name: Vitality of the Tree
features.description: Your Rage taps into life force, providing Temporary Hit Points.

benefits.name: Vitality Surge
benefits.description: Gain Temp HP equal to your Barbarian level when entering Rage.

benefits.name: Life-Giving Force
benefits.description: At the start of each turn while Raging, an ally within 10ft gains Temp HP (roll d6s equal to Rage Damage bonus). These vanish when Rage ends.

features.name: Branches of the Tree
features.description: When a creature within 30ft starts its turn, use a Reaction to force a Strength save. Fail: Teleport them within 5ft of you and potentially reduce their Speed to 0 until end of turn.

features.name: Battering Roots
features.description: Reach increases by 10ft with Heavy/Versatile weapons on your turn. When you hit, you can use Push or Topple in addition to another mastery property.

features.name: Travel along the Tree
features.description: Teleport 60ft when entering Rage and as a Bonus Action while Raging. Once per Rage, increase range to 150ft and bring up to six willing creatures within 10ft of you.

subclasses.name: Path of the Zealot
subclasses.description: Barbarians who walk the Path of the Zealot receive boons from a god or pantheon, experiencing their Rage as an ecstatic episode of divine union.

features.name: Divine Fury
features.description: While Raging, the first creature you hit on your turn takes an extra 1d6 + half Barbarian level damage (Necrotic or Radiant).

features.name: Warrior of the Gods
features.description: Spend dice from a pool of d12s to heal yourself as a Bonus Action. Pool size increases with level.

features.name: Fanatical Focus
features.description: Once per Rage, if you fail a save, reroll it with a bonus equal to your Rage Damage bonus.

features.name: Zealous Presence
features.description: Give Advantage on attack rolls and saves to up to 10 allies within 60ft until the start of your next turn. Restore use by expending one Rage.

features.name: Rage of the Gods
features.description: Assume a divine warrior form for 1 minute (or until 0 HP):

benefits.name: Flight
benefits.description: Gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed and can hover.

benefits.name: Resistance
benefits.description: Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant damage.

benefits.name: Revivification
benefits.description: When a creature within 30ft drops to 0 HP, use a Reaction and expend a Rage to change their HP to your Barbarian level.

subclasses.name: College of Dance
subclasses.description: Bards of the College of Dance believe the Words of Creation are expressed through movement, emphasizing agility, speed, and grace in harmony with the cosmos.

features.name: Dazzling Footwork
features.description: While not wearing armor or a shield, gain several movement-based benefits.

benefits.name: Dance Virtuoso
benefits.description: Advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks involving dancing.

benefits.name: Unarmored Defense
benefits.description: Base AC = 10 + Dexterity + Charisma.

benefits.name: Agile Strikes
benefits.description: When you spend a Bardic Inspiration use, make an Unarmed Strike as part of the same action/reaction.

benefits.name: Bardic Damage
benefits.description: Use Dexterity for Unarmed Strike attack/damage. Damage = Bardic Inspiration die + Dex modifier (doesn't spend the die).

features.name: Inspiring Movement
features.description: When an enemy ends its turn within 5ft, use a Reaction to move half speed (no OA). An ally within 30ft can also move half speed using their reaction.

features.name: Tandem Footwork
features.description: On Initiative, spend a Bardic Inspiration to add the die roll to the Initiative of yourself and allies within 30ft.

features.name: Leading Evasion
features.description: Gain Evasion (no damage on successful Dex save). Share this benefit with creatures within 5ft for the same save. Inactive if Incapacitated.

subclasses.name: College of Glamour
subclasses.description: Bards of the College of Glamour trace their magic to the Feywild, weaving beauty and terror into their performances to cloak themselves in otherworldly majesty.

features.name: Beguiling Magic
features.refresh: Long Rest or expend Bardic Inspiration
features.description: Always have Charm Person and Mirror Image prepared. After casting an Enchantment or Illusion spell slot, force a creature within 60ft to make a Wisdom save or be Charmed/Frightened for 1 minute (repeat save at end of turns). Restore use by expending one Bardic Inspiration.

features.name: Mantle of Inspiration
features.description: As a Bonus Action, roll a Bardic Inspiration die. Choose allies up to your Charisma mod within 60ft; they gain Temp HP equal to 2x the roll and can use their Reaction to move their Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Mantle of Majesty
features.refresh: Long Rest or expend Level 3+ spell slot
features.description: Always have Command prepared. As a Bonus Action, cast Command without a slot and assume a majestic form for 1 minute (Concentration). During this time, cast Command as a Bonus Action without a slot. Charmed creatures auto-fail the save. Restore use by expending a level 3+ spell slot.

features.name: Unbreakable Majesty
features.description: Assume a majestic presence for 1 minute. The first time a creature hits you on a turn, it must make a Charisma save or the attack misses.

subclasses.name: College of Lore
subclasses.description: Bards of the College of Lore collect spells and secrets from diverse sources, sharing knowledge in libraries and universities to expose corruption and unravel lies.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

features.name: Cutting Words
features.description: When a creature within 60ft makes a damage roll or succeeds on an ability check or attack roll, use a Reaction and spend a Bardic Inspiration to subtract the die roll from the creature's total.

features.name: Magical Discoveries

choice.options: Cantrips or Spells from Cleric, Druid, or Wizard lists

features.description: Learn two spells of your choice from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard lists. They must be cantrips or of a level you can cast. You always have them prepared and can swap one on level up.

features.name: Peerless Skill
features.description: When you fail an ability check or attack roll, add a Bardic Inspiration die to the total. If you still fail, the die isn't expended.

subclasses.name: College of Spirits
subclasses.description: Bards of the College of Spirits conjure capricious legendary spirits to change the world, letting their power and knowledge flow through music and story.

features.name: Channeler
features.description: Gain the Guidance cantrip (60ft range). You gain proficiency with a Gaming Set (playing cards) and can use it or other specific items as a focus.

benefits.name: Guiding Whispers
benefits.description: Know Guidance; range is 60ft.

benefits.name: Spiritual Focus
benefits.description: Gain proficiency with cards. Use cards, crystal, orb, candle, or ink pen as a focus.

features.name: Spirits from Beyond
features.action: Bonus Action (to channel), Magic Action (to unleash)
features.description: Channel a random spirit when giving Bardic Inspiration, or spend a use to pick one (Controlled Channeling). Use a Magic action to unleash its effect on a creature within 30ft.

rows.name: Beloved
rows.result: Target regains HP equal to Bardic Inspiration die + Charisma modifier.

rows.name: Sharpshooter
rows.result: Target takes Force damage equal to Bardic Inspiration die + Charisma modifier.

rows.name: Avenger
rows.result: Until end of your next turn, any creature that hits the target with a melee attack takes Force damage equal to Bardic Inspiration die.

rows.name: Renegade
rows.result: Target can use a Reaction to teleport up to 30ft.

rows.name: Fortune Teller
rows.result: Target has Advantage on D20 Tests until the start of your next turn.

rows.name: Wayfarer
rows.result: Target gains Temp HP equal to Bardic Inspiration die + Bard level; Speed increases by 10ft while they last.

rows.name: Trickster
rows.result: Wis save or take Psychic damage (2x die) and be Charmed until start of your next turn. Half damage on success.

rows.name: Shade
rows.result: Target becomes Invisible until they attack/cast. When it ends, creatures in 5ft Emanation must Con save or take Necrotic damage (2x die).

rows.name: Arsonist
rows.result: Dex save or take Fire damage (4x die). Half damage on success.

rows.name: Coward
rows.result: Target and chosen creatures in 30ft Emanation make Wis save or be Frightened (Speed halved, only Action OR Bonus Action) until start of your next turn.

rows.name: Brute
rows.result: Chosen creatures in 30ft Emanation make Str save or take Thunder damage (3x die) and are Prone. Half damage on success.

rows.name: Priest
rows.result: Target regains HP (2x die) and one condition ends (Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned).

features.name: Empowered Channeling
features.description: Improve your spirit channeling and spellcasting.

benefits.name: Power from Beyond
benefits.description: Once per turn, +1d6 to a Bard spell's damage or healing (if cast with a slot).

benefits.name: Spiritual Manifestation
benefits.refresh: Long Rest (spell), Short or Long Rest (Half Cover)
benefits.description: Always have Spirit Guardians prepared. Cast once per Long Rest without a slot. Can modify it to grant Half Cover to allies in the emanation (once per Short/Long Rest).

features.name: Mystical Connection
features.description: When rolling on the Spirits from Beyond table, roll twice and pick one. If you roll doubles, you can pick any effect on the table.

subclasses.name: College of Valor
subclasses.description: Bards of the College of Valor are daring storytellers whose tales preserve the memory of ancient heroes, inspiring new generations to match their legendary deeds.

features.name: Combat Inspiration
features.description: Creatures with your Bardic Inspiration can use it for defense or offense:

benefits.name: Defense
benefits.description: When hit by an attack, roll the die and add it to AC for that attack.

benefits.name: Offense
benefits.description: After hitting with an attack, roll the die and add it to the damage.

features.name: Martial Training
features.description: Gain proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor and Shields. You can use a weapon as a spellcasting focus for Bard spells.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice per Attack action. You can replace one attack with a cantrip (1 action casting time).

features.name: Battle Magic
features.description: After casting a spell (1 action), make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

subclasses.name: Grave Domain
subclasses.description: The Grave Domain concerns itself with the boundary between life and death, seeking to destroy undead and shepherd spirits while staving off death for a time.

features.name: Grave Domain Spells
features.description: You always have certain spells prepared when you reach certain levels.

features.name: Circle of Mortality
features.description: Manipulate the balance between life and death.

benefits.name: Pull of Death
benefits.description: Once per turn, deal an extra 1d4 Necrotic damage (1d6 at L11) to a creature missing Hit Points.

benefits.name: Return to Life
benefits.description: Cast Spare the Dying as a Bonus Action. Additionally, when healing a creature at 0 HP, use the highest possible number for each die.

features.name: Path to the Grave
features.description: As a Bonus Action, curse a creature within 30ft until your next turn (Disadvantage on attacks/saves). If you or an ally hits them, end curse early to deal extra damage equal to your Cleric level.

features.name: Sentinel at Death's Door
features.description: When you or a Bloodied creature within 60ft is hit, use a Reaction to halve the damage and cancel Critical Hit effects.

features.name: Divine Reaper
features.description: Harbinger of death benefits.

benefits.name: Enhanced Necromancy
benefits.description: When casting a single-target Necromancy spell (L5 or lower) or a Grave Domain spell, spend a Channel Divinity to target a second creature.

benefits.name: Keeper of Souls
benefits.refresh: Short or Long Rest (or Level 6+ slot)
benefits.description: When an enemy dies within 60ft, you or an ally within 60ft regains HP equal to 2x Cleric level. Restore use with a level 6+ spell slot.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.description: You always have certain spells prepared after you reach particular levels in this class, as shown in the Knowledge Domain Spells table.

features.name: Blessings of Knowledge
features.description: You learn two languages of your choice. You also become proficient in your choice of two of the following skills: Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion. Your Proficiency Bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of those skills.

features.name: Knowledge of the Ages
features.description: As a Magic action, you can use your Channel Divinity to choose one skill or tool. For 10 minutes, you have proficiency with the chosen skill or tool.

features.name: Read Thoughts
features.description: As a Magic action, you can use your Channel Divinity to read a creature's thoughts. Choose a creature within 60 feet. It must make a Wisdom save. On a success, you can't use this feature on it again until you finish a Long Rest. On a failure, you can read its surface thoughts for 1 minute as long as you maintain Concentration. During this time, you can use your Action to cast Suggestion on the creature without spending a slot; the creature automatically fails its save.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.description: You add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any Cleric cantrip.

features.name: Visions of the Past
features.description: You can call up visions of the past that relate to an object you hold or your immediate surroundings. You spend at least 1 minute in meditation, then receive dreamlike, shadowy glimpses of recent events. You can meditate in this way for a number of minutes equal to your Wisdom score and must maintain Concentration. You can use this feature to learn about Object Reading (who owned it, how it was used) or Area Reading (recent significant events within 50 feet). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Lunar Inspiration
features.description: When a creature uses a Bardic Inspiration die from you, they can choose to roll it twice and take either result.

features.name: Moonlight Magic
features.description: You learn the Dancing Lights and Faerie Fire spells. They don't count against your number of spells prepared. You can cast Faerie Fire once per Long Rest without a slot.

features.name: Waxing and Waning
features.description: Your Bardic Inspiration becomes more powerful with the phases of the moon. During a New Moon, it grants a bonus to Stealth. During a Full Moon, it grants a bonus to damage rolls.

features.name: Lunar Radiance
features.description: As an Action, you can emit a burst of moonlight in a 30-foot radius. Enemies make a Constitution save or are Blinded and take 4d10 Radiant damage.

features.name: Life Domain
features.description: The Life Domain focuses on the positive energy that helps sustain all life in the multiverse, making these Clerics masters of healing.

features.name: Life Domain Spells
features.description: You always have certain spells prepared when you reach certain levels.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.description: When you cast a healing spell with a slot, the target regains additional HP equal to 2 + spell slot level.

features.name: Preserve Life
features.description: Restore HP equal to 5x Cleric level, divided among Bloodied creatures within 30ft (max half their HP maximum).

features.name: Blessed Healer
features.description: When you heal others with a spell slot, you regain HP equal to 2 + spell slot level.

features.name: Supreme Healing
features.description: When you heal with a spell or Channel Divinity, use the highest possible number for each die instead of rolling.

features.name: Light Domain
features.description: The Light Domain emphasizes the divine power to bring about blazing fire and revelation, using radiance to chase away lies and burn away darkness.

features.name: Light Domain Spells
features.description: You always have certain spells prepared when you reach certain levels.

features.name: Radiance of the Dawn
features.description: Emit light in a 30ft Emanation. Dispel magical darkness and each chosen creature must make a Con save. Fail: 2d10 + Cleric level Radiant damage. Success: half damage.

features.name: Warding Flare
features.description: When a creature within 30ft makes an attack roll, use a Reaction to impose Disadvantage on the roll.

features.name: Improved Warding Flare
features.description: Regain Warding Flare uses on a Short Rest. Additionally, Warding Flare grants the attack target 2d6 + Wis mod Temporary Hit Points.

features.name: Corona of Light
features.description: Emit sunlight (60ft Bright, 30ft Dim) for 1 minute. Enemies in Bright Light have Disadvantage on saves against your Radiance of the Dawn and Fire/Radiant spells.

features.name: Trickery Domain
features.description: The Trickery Domain offers magic of deception, illusion, and stealth, puncturing pride and mocking tyrants through subterfuge and pranks.

features.name: Trickery Domain Spells
features.description: You always have certain spells prepared when you reach certain levels.

features.name: Blessing of the Trickster
features.description: Grant yourself or an ally within 30ft Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Lasts until a Long Rest or reused.

features.name: Invoke Duplicity
features.description: Create an illusion of yourself within 30ft for 1 minute. Move it 30ft as a Bonus Action. Cast spells as if in its space (using your senses). If you and the illusion are within 5ft of a creature, you have Advantage on attack rolls against it.

features.name: Trickster's Transposition
features.description: When you use a Bonus Action to create or move your Invoke Duplicity illusion, you can teleport and swap places with it.

features.name: Improved Duplicity
features.description: Invoke Duplicity improvements.

benefits.name: Shared Distraction
benefits.description: You and allies have Advantage on attack rolls against a creature within 5ft of the illusion.

benefits.name: Healing Illusion
benefits.description: When the illusion ends, you or a creature within 5ft of it regains HP equal to your Cleric level.

features.name: War Domain
features.description: Clerics of the War Domain excel in battle, inspiring others to fight the good fight or offering acts of violence as prayers.

features.name: War Domain Spells
features.description: You always have certain spells prepared when you reach certain levels.

features.name: Guided Strike
features.description: When you or a creature within 30ft misses an attack, add +10 to the roll. If used for another creature, it requires a Reaction.

features.name: War Priest
features.description: As a Bonus Action, make one attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike.

features.name: War God's Blessing
features.description: Expend a Channel Divinity to cast Shield of Faith or Spiritual Weapon without a slot or Concentration (lasts 1 minute).

features.name: Avatar of Battle
features.description: You gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

features.name: Circle of the Land
features.description: Druids of the Circle of the Land are mystics and sages who safeguard ancient knowledge and rites, connecting deeply to specific natural environments.

features.name: Circle of the Land Spells
features.description: After a Long Rest, choose a land type. You prepare spells based on that type and your Druid level.

features.name: Land's Aid
features.description: Target a point within 60ft (10ft Sphere). Chosen creatures make a Con save or take 2d6 Necrotic damage (half on success). One creature regains 2d6 HP. Dice increase at L10 (3d6) and L14 (4d6).

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.description: Cast one Circle Spell once per Long Rest without a slot. Additionally, during a Short Rest (once per Long Rest), recover expended spell slots with combined level <= half Druid level (max level 5 slots).

features.name: Nature's Ward
features.description: You are immune to the Poisoned condition and gain Resistance based on your current Land choice: Arid (Fire), Polar (Cold), Temperate (Lightning), Tropical (Poison).

features.name: Nature's Sanctuary
features.description: Create a 15ft Cube within 120ft for 1 minute. You and allies have Half Cover and gain your current Nature's Ward Resistance while inside. Move the cube 60ft as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Circle of the Moon
features.description: Druids of the Circle of the Moon draw on lunar magic to transform into powerful animal forms to guard the wilds.

features.name: Circle Forms
features.description: Improved Wild Shape benefits.

benefits.name: Challenge Rating
benefits.description: Max CR = Druid level / 3 (round down).

benefits.name: Armor Class
benefits.description: AC = 13 + Wisdom modifier (if higher than Beast's AC).

benefits.name: Temporary Hit Points
benefits.description: Gain Temp HP = 3x Druid level.

features.name: Circle of the Moon Spells
features.description: Always have these spells prepared. You can cast them while in Wild Shape.

features.name: Improved Circle Forms
features.description: While in Wild Shape, attacks can deal Radiant damage. Additionally, add your Wisdom modifier to your Constitution saving throws.

features.name: Moonlight Step
features.refresh: Long Rest or expend Level 2+ spell slot
features.description: Teleport 30ft as a Bonus Action and gain Advantage on your next attack roll this turn. Restore one use with a level 2+ spell slot.

features.name: Lunar Form
features.description: Lunar power benefits.

benefits.name: Improved Lunar Radiance
benefits.description: Once per turn, deal an extra 2d10 Radiant damage with a Wild Shape attack.

benefits.name: Shared Moonlight
benefits.description: Teleport an ally within 10ft when you use Moonlight Step.

features.name: Circle of the Sea
features.description: Druids of the Circle of the Sea draw on the tempestuous forces of oceans and storms, attuning themselves to the ebb and flow of tides and the power of winds.

features.name: Circle of the Sea Spells
features.description: Always have these spells prepared.

features.name: Wrath of the Sea
features.description: Manifest a 5ft Emanation (ocean spray) for 10 minutes. As a Bonus Action on your turns, target a creature in the area. They must make a Con save or take Cold damage (d6s = Wis mod) and be pushed 15ft if Large or smaller.

features.name: Aquatic Affinity
features.description: Wrath of the Sea Emanation increases to 10ft. Gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Stormborn
features.description: While Wrath of the Sea is active, gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed and Resistance to Cold, Lightning, and Thunder damage.

features.name: Oceanic Gift
features.description: Manifest Wrath of the Sea around an ally within 60ft instead of yourself. Or spend 2 Wild Shape uses to manifest it around both of you.

features.name: Circle of the Stars
features.description: Druids of the Circle of the Stars track heavenly patterns and constellations to harness the powers of the cosmos.

features.name: Star Map
features.description: You have a Tiny star chart that serves as a spellcasting focus. It grants you Guidance and Guiding Bolt (cast Guiding Bolt without a slot Wisdom modifier times per Long Rest).

rows.result: A scroll bearing depictions of constellations
A stone tablet with fine holes drilled through it
An owlbear hide tooled with stellar symbols
A collection of maps bound in an ebony cover
A crystal engraved with starry patterns
A glass disk etched with constellations

features.name: Starry Form
features.description: Take on a luminous form for 10 minutes. Choose a constellation benefit:

options.name: Archer
options.description: Make a ranged spell attack (60ft) for 1d8 + Wis mod Radiant damage.

options.name: Chalice
options.description: When healing with a spell slot, you or an ally within 30ft regains 1d8 + Wis mod HP.

options.name: Dragon
options.description: Treat rolls of 9 or lower as 10 for Int/Wis checks and Con saves for Concentration.

features.name: Cosmic Omen
features.description: After a Long Rest, roll a die. Even (Weal): Use a Reaction to add 1d6 to a D20 Test within 30ft. Odd (Woe): Use a Reaction to subtract 1d6 from a D20 Test within 30ft.

features.name: Twinkling Constellations
features.description: Starry Form improves: Archer and Chalice dice become 2d8; Dragon grants 20ft Fly Speed (hover). You can change constellations at the start of each turn while in form.

features.name: Full of Stars
features.description: While in Starry Form, you have Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

features.name: Battle Master
features.description: Battle Masters are students of the art of battle, combining martial prowess with academic study to master sophisticated maneuvers.

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.description: Learn maneuvers fueled by Superiority Dice (d8s; become d10 at L10, d12 at L18). DCs use Str or Dex.

benefits.name: Maneuvers
benefits.description: Learn 3 maneuvers initially. Learn 2 more at L7, L10, L15. Only one per attack.

benefits.name: Superiority Dice
benefits.description: Have 4 dice initially. Gain 1 more at L7 and L15.

features.name: Student of War
features.description: Gain proficiency with one type of Artisan's Tools and one Fighter skill.

features.name: Know Your Enemy
features.refresh: Long Rest or expend Superiority Die
features.description: As a Bonus Action, learn a creature's Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities. Restore use by expending a Superiority Die.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: Once per turn, when you use a maneuver, roll 1d8 to use instead of expending a Superiority Die.

maneuvers.name: Ambush
maneuvers.description: Add die to Stealth check or Initiative roll (unless Incapacitated).

maneuvers.name: Bait and Switch
maneuvers.description: Switch places with willing ally (no OA); one of you gains AC bonus equal to die roll.

maneuvers.name: Commander's Strike
maneuvers.description: Replace one attack to let an ally use a Reaction to attack (add die to damage).

maneuvers.name: Commanding Presence
maneuvers.description: Add die to Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion check.

maneuvers.name: Disarming Attack
maneuvers.description: Add die to damage; target makes Str save or drops one held object.

maneuvers.name: Distracting Strike
maneuvers.description: Add die to damage; next ally's attack roll against target has Advantage.

maneuvers.name: Evasive Footwork
maneuvers.description: Take Disengage action and add die to AC until next turn.

maneuvers.name: Feinting Attack
maneuvers.description: Gain Advantage on next attack against target within 5ft; add die to damage.

maneuvers.name: Goading Attack
maneuvers.description: Add die to damage; target makes Wis save or has Disadvantage on attacks against others.

maneuvers.name: Lunging Attack
maneuvers.description: Take Dash action; if you move 5ft straight before a melee hit, add die to damage.

maneuvers.name: Maneuvering Attack
maneuvers.description: Add die to damage; ally can use Reaction to move half speed (no OA from target).

maneuvers.name: Menacing Attack
maneuvers.description: Add die to damage; target makes Wis save or is Frightened until end of your next turn.

maneuvers.name: Parry
maneuvers.description: Reduce melee damage by die roll + Str or Dex modifier.

maneuvers.name: Precision Attack
maneuvers.description: Add die to an attack roll after seeing the roll but before knowing if it hits.

maneuvers.name: Pushing Attack
maneuvers.description: Add die to damage; Large or smaller target makes Str save or is pushed 15ft.

maneuvers.name: Rally
maneuvers.description: Ally within 30ft gains Temp HP equal to die roll + half Fighter level.

maneuvers.name: Riposte
maneuvers.description: When missed by melee attack, use Reaction to attack (add die to damage).

maneuvers.name: Sweeping Attack
maneuvers.description: Hit second creature within 5ft of target for damage equal to die roll (same type).

maneuvers.name: Tactical Assessment
maneuvers.description: Add die to History, Investigation, or Insight check.

maneuvers.name: Trip Attack
maneuvers.description: Add die to damage; Large or smaller target makes Str save or is knocked Prone.

features.name: Champion
features.description: A Champion focuses on physical excellence and relentless martial prowess to deal devastating blows and withstand peril.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.description: Your weapon and Unarmed Strike attack rolls score a Critical Hit on a 19 or 20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.description: Gain Advantage on Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks. After a Critical Hit, you can move half your Speed (no OA).

features.name: Additional Fighting Style
features.description: Gain another Fighting Style feat of your choice.

features.name: Heroic Warrior
features.description: In combat, gain Heroic Inspiration at the start of your turn if you don't have it.

features.name: Superior Critical
features.description: Your weapon and Unarmed Strike attack rolls score a Critical Hit on an 18-20.

features.name: Survivor
features.description: RESILIENCE pinnacle benefits:

benefits.name: Defy Death
benefits.description: Advantage on Death Saving Throws; 18-20 counts as a 20.

benefits.name: Heroic Rally
benefits.description: At the start of your turn, regain HP equal to 5 + Con modifier if Bloodied (and >= 1 HP).

features.name: Eldritch Knight
features.description: Eldritch Knights combine martial mastery with careful study of arcane magic, using spells to complement their combat skills and provide explosive protection.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability. You use an Arcane Focus. You know Wizard cantrips and prepare Wizard spells from the Eldritch Knight Spellcasting table. Change your prepared spells or one cantrip on a level up.

features.name: War Bond
features.description: Bond with up to two weapons via a 1-hour ritual. You can't be disarmed of them unless Incapacitated. Summon a bonded weapon to your hand as a Bonus Action.

features.name: War Magic
features.description: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one attack with a Wizard cantrip (1 action casting time).

features.name: Eldritch Strike
features.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, they have Disadvantage on their next saving throw against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Arcane Charge
features.description: When you use Action Surge, teleport up to 30ft before or after the additional action.

features.name: Improved War Magic
features.description: When you take the Attack action, you can replace two attacks with Wizard spells of level 1 or 2 (1 action casting time).

features.name: Psi Warrior
features.description: Psi Warriors awaken the power of their minds to augment their physical might, creating telekinetic barriers and infusing strikes with mental force.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.description: Harbor a wellspring of Psionic Energy Dice to fuel powers. Regain 1 die on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest.

benefits.name: Protective Field
benefits.description: Reduce damage taken by you or a creature within 30ft by roll + Int modifier (min 1).

benefits.name: Psionic Strike
benefits.description: Once per turn on a weapon hit within 30ft, deal extra Force damage equal to roll + Int modifier.

benefits.name: Telekinetic Movement
benefits.description: Transport a Large or smaller loose object or willing creature within 30ft up to 30ft. Tiny objects can go to/from your hand.

features.name: Telekinetic Adept
features.description: Mastered psionic techniques.

benefits.name: Psi-Powered Leap
benefits.description: Gain Fly Speed equal to 2x Speed until end of turn.

benefits.name: Telekinetic Thrust
benefits.description: When dealing Psionic Strike damage, force a Strength save or the target is Prone or moved 10ft horizontally.

features.name: Guarded Mind
features.description: Gain Resistance to Psychic damage. If you start your turn Charmed or Frightened, expend one die to end the condition.

features.name: Bulwark of Force
features.description: Choose creatures up to Int modifier within 30ft; they gain Half Cover for 1 minute.

features.name: Telekinetic Master
features.description: Always have Telekinesis prepared. Cast once per Long Rest without a slot (Intelligence based). While concentrating on it, make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Warrior of Mercy
features.description: Warriors of Mercy manipulate life force to heal or harm, acting as wandering physicians who bring swift ends to their enemies.

features.name: Hand of Harm
features.description: Once per turn on an Unarmed Strike hit, spend 1 Focus Point to deal extra Necrotic damage (Martial Arts die + Wis mod).

features.name: Hand of Healing
features.description: As a Magic action, spend 1 Focus Point to heal (Martial Arts die + Wis mod). In Flurry of Blows, replace one strike with this healing for 0 points.

features.name: Implements of Mercy
features.description: Gain proficiency in Insight, Medicine, and Herbalism Kit.

features.name: Physician's Touch
features.description: Improve Hand of Harm (adds Poisoned condition until end of next turn) and Hand of Healing (removes Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned).

features.name: Flurry of Healing and Harm
features.description: In Flurry of Blows: replace strikes with Hand of Healing (0 cost) and use Hand of Harm on a hit (0 cost; once/turn).

features.name: Hand of Ultimate Mercy
features.description: Touch a creature dead for <24 hours; spend 5 Focus Points to revive them with 4d10 + Wis mod HP and remove specific conditions.

features.name: Warrior of Shadow
features.description: Warriors of Shadow harness the power of the Shadowfell for stealth and subterfuge, becoming masters of darkness and teleportation.

features.name: Shadow Arts
features.description: Harness shadow magic.

benefits.name: Darkness
benefits.description: Cast Darkness (no components); you can see within its area. Move the area 60ft at start of turn.

benefits.name: Darkvision
benefits.description: Gain 60ft Darkvision (or +60ft to existing).

benefits.name: Shadowy Figments
benefits.description: Know Minor Illusion (Wisdom based).

features.name: Shadow Step
features.description: While in Dim Light/Darkness, teleport 60ft to Dim Light/Darkness. Gain Advantage on next melee attack this turn.

features.name: Improved Shadow Step
features.description: Spend 1 Focus Point to remove light requirements for Shadow Step and make one Unarmed Strike as part of the action.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
features.description: In Dim Light/Darkness, spend 3 Focus Points for 1 minute of Invisibility, movement through spaces (Difficult Terrain), and 0-cost Flurry of Blows. Ends if you end turn in Bright Light.

features.name: Warrior of the Elements
features.description: Warriors of the Elements tame the Elemental Chaos to empower themselves, wielding strikes and bursts of elemental power.

features.name: Elemental Attunement
features.description: At the start of your turn, spend 1 Focus Point to imbue yourself with elemental energy for 10 minutes. Reach increases by 10ft. Unarmed Strikes can deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage. On a hit with these types, force a Strength save or move the target 10ft toward/away from you.

features.name: Manipulate Elements
features.description: Know the Elementalism spell (Wisdom based).

features.name: Elemental Burst
features.description: Cause a 20ft-radius Sphere burst within 120ft. Target creatures make a Dex save or take 3 rolls of Martial Arts die in Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage (half on success).

features.name: Stride of the Elements
features.description: While Elemental Attunement is active, gain Fly and Swim speeds equal to your Speed.

features.name: Elemental Epitome
features.description: Elemental Attunement improvements.

benefits.name: Damage Resistance
benefits.description: Choose Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder (changeable at start of turns).

benefits.name: Destructive Stride
benefits.description: +20ft Speed during Step of the Wind. Creatures within 5ft of you take 1 roll of Martial Arts die damage (Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder) once per turn.

benefits.name: Empowered Strikes
benefits.description: Once per turn, deal extra damage equal to 1 Martial Arts die on an Unarmed Strike hit.

features.name: Warrior of the Open Hand
features.description: Warriors of the Open Hand are masters of unarmed combat, utilizing techniques to push, trip, and lethal vibrations to defeat foes.

features.name: Open Hand Technique
features.description: In Flurry of Blows, impose an effect on a hit:

options.name: Addle
options.description: Target can't make Opportunity Attacks until start of its next turn.

options.name: Push
options.description: Target pushed 15ft away from you.

options.name: Topple
options.description: Target knocked Prone.

features.name: Wholeness of Body
features.description: As a Bonus Action, regain HP equal to Martial Arts die + Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Fleet Step
features.description: When you take a Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind, you can also use Step of the Wind immediately after.

features.name: Quivering Palm
features.description: On Unarmed Strike hit, spend 4 Focus Points to start vibrations (lasts days = level). Use an Action (or replace one attack) to end them: target makes Con save or takes 10d12 Force damage (half on success).

features.name: Oath of Devotion
features.description: The Oath of Devotion binds Paladins to the ideals of justice and order, embodying the archetype of the knight in shining armor.

features.name: Oath of Devotion Spells
features.description: Always have these spells prepared.

features.name: Sacred Weapon
features.description: Imbue a Melee weapon with positive energy: add Charisma modifier to attack rolls, deal normal or Radiant damage, and emit light (20ft Bright, 20ft Dim).

features.name: Aura of Devotion
features.description: You and allies within your Aura of Protection are immune to the Charmed condition.

features.name: Smite of Protection
features.description: Whenever you cast Divine Smite, you and allies have Half Cover while in your Aura of Protection until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Holy Nimbus
features.refresh: Long Rest or expend Level 5 spell slot
features.description: Imbue your aura with holy power: Advantage on saves vs Fiends/Undead; enemies starting turn in aura take Radiant damage (Cha mod + PB); area filled with sunlight.

features.name: Oath of Glory
features.description: Paladins of the Oath of Glory believe they are destined to achieve greatness through deeds of heroism, encouraging their companions to strive for glory.

features.name: Oath of Glory Spells
features.description: Always have these spells prepared.

features.name: Inspiring Smite
features.description: After casting Divine Smite, distribute Temp HP (2d8 + Paladin level) to creatures within 30ft.

features.name: Peerless Athlete
features.description: Gain Advantage on Athletics/Acrobatics checks and increase jump distance by 10ft.

features.name: Aura of Alacrity
features.description: Your speed increases by 10ft. Allies starting turns in your Aura of Protection also gain +10ft speed until end of their next turn.

features.name: Glorious Defense
features.description: When a creature within 10ft is hit, use a Reaction to add your Cha mod to their AC. If the attack misses, you can make one weapon attack against the attacker.

features.name: Living Legend
features.refresh: Long Rest or expend Level 5 spell slot
features.description: Gain Advantage on Charisma checks. Use a Reaction to reroll a failed save. Once per turn, turn a missed weapon attack into a hit.

features.name: Oath of the Ancients
features.description: The Oath of the Ancients is as old as the first elves, cherishing beauty and life-giving things to preserve life and light in the world.

features.name: Oath of the Ancients Spells
features.description: Always have these spells prepared.

features.name: Nature's Wrath
features.description: Conjure vines within 15ft. Chosen creatures make a Strength save or be Restrained for 1 minute (repeat save at end of turns).

features.name: Aura of Warding
features.description: You and allies in your Aura of Protection have Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant damage.

features.name: Undying Sentinel
features.description: When reduced to 0 HP, drop to 1 HP instead and regain HP equal to 3x Paladin level. Additionally, you cannot be aged magically and cease visibly aging.

features.name: Elder Champion
features.refresh: Long Rest or expend Level 5 spell slot
features.description: Imbue your aura with primal power: enemies have Disadvantage on saves vs your spells/CD; regain 10 HP at start of each turn; cast Action spells as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Oath of Vengeance
features.description: The Oath of Vengeance is a solemn commitment to punish evildoers at any cost, setting right what has gone wrong through relentless pursuit.

features.name: Oath of Vengeance Spells
features.description: Always have these spells prepared.

features.name: Vow of Enmity
features.description: Gain Advantage on attack rolls against a creature within 30ft. If it drops to 0 HP, transfer the vow to another creature within 30ft (no action).

features.name: Relentless Avenger
features.description: When hitting with an Opportunity Attack, reduce target Speed to 0 and move up to half your Speed as part of the same Reaction (no OA).

features.name: Soul of Vengeance
features.description: Immediately after your Vow of Enmity target attacks, use a Reaction to make a melee attack against them.

features.name: Avenging Angel
features.refresh: Long Rest or expend Level 5 spell slot
features.description: Gain a 60ft Fly Speed (hover) and a Frightful Aura: enemies starting turn in aura make a Wis save or be Frightened (Advantage on attacks vs them).

features.name: Beast Master
features.description: A Beast Master forms a mystical bond with a special animal, drawing on primal magic and a deep connection to the natural world.

features.name: Primal Companion
features.description: Summon a primal beast (Land, Sea, or Sky). It obeys your commands in combat (uses your Bonus Action or replaces one attack for Beast's Strike).

options.name: Beast of the Land
options.description: Medium; 40ft/Climb 40ft. Atk: 1d8+2+Wis. Charge 20ft for +1d6 and Prone.

options.name: Beast of the Sea
options.description: Medium; 5ft/Swim 60ft. Atk: 1d6+2+Wis. Target is Grappled (save DC = your Spell Save DC).

options.name: Beast of the Sky
options.description: Small; 10ft/Fly 60ft. Atk: 1d4+3+Wis. Flyby (no Opportunity Attacks).

features.name: Exceptional Training
features.description: Command beast to Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help as a Bonus Action. Attacks can deal Force damage.

features.name: Bestial Fury
features.description: Beast can attack twice. Deals extra Force damage equal to your Hunter's Mark bonus once per turn.

features.name: Share Spells
features.description: Spells you cast on yourself also affect your beast if within 30ft.

features.name: Fey Wanderer
features.description: Fey Wanderers represent the mirth and fury of the fey, utilizing beguiling magic and otherworldly glamour in their travels.

features.name: Dreadful Strikes
features.description: Once per turn, deal extra 1d4 Psychic damage (1d6 at L11) on a weapon hit.

features.name: Otherworldly Glamour
features.description: Add Wisdom modifier to Charisma checks. Gain proficiency in one listed skill.

features.name: Beguiling Twist
features.description: Advantage on saves vs Charmed/Frightened. When someone within 120ft succeeds on such a save, use a Reaction to force another creature within 120ft to make a Wis save or be Charmed/Frightened for 1 minute.

features.name: Fey Reinforcements
features.description: Cast Summon Fey without a slot or components once per Long Rest. Can cast without Concentration (1 min duration).

features.name: Misty Wanderer
features.description: Cast Misty Step for free. Bring along one willing creature within 5ft.

features.name: Gloom Stalker
features.description: Gloom Stalkers wield magic drawn from the Shadowfell to combat enemies that lurk in darkness, mastering fearsome ambushes and shadow magic.

features.name: Dread Ambusher
features.description: Master ambushes with multiple benefits.

benefits.name: Ambusher's Leap
benefits.description: +10ft Speed on your first turn of combat.

benefits.name: Dreadful Strike
benefits.description: Once per turn on a weapon hit, deal extra 2d6 (2d8 at L11) Psychic damage.

benefits.name: Initiative Bonus
benefits.description: Add Wisdom modifier to Initiative rolls.

features.name: Umbral Sight
features.description: Gain 60ft Darkvision (or +60ft). While entirely in Darkness, you are Invisible to creatures relying on Darkvision to see you.

features.name: Iron Mind
features.description: Gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws (or Int/Cha if already proficient).

features.name: Stalker's Flurry
features.description: Psychic damage of Dreadful Strike becomes 2d8. When you use it, add one effect:

options.name: Sudden Strike
options.description: Make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature within 5ft of the target.

options.name: Mass Fear
options.description: Target and creatures within 10ft make a Wisdom save or are Frightened until start of your next turn.

features.name: Shadowy Dodge
features.description: When attacked, use a Reaction to impose Disadvantage. Hit or miss, you can teleport up to 30ft.

features.name: Hollow Warden
features.description: Hollow Wardens draw power from ancient wild terrors, transforming themselves into merciless and monstrous guardians.

features.name: Wrath of the Wild
features.description: Transform into a ghastly form.

benefits.name: Ancient Armor
benefits.description: +1 bonus to AC (+2 at L11).

benefits.name: Prowling Retribution
benefits.description: Make an Opportunity Attack immediately after a creature within 5ft damages you or an ally.

benefits.name: Unnerving Aura
benefits.description: At the start of your turns, chosen creatures in a 10ft Emanation make a Wisdom save or are Frightened until start of your next turn.

features.name: Hungering Might
features.description: Gain bonus to Con saves equal to Wis mod (min +1). Once per turn when hitting while transformed and Bloodied, regain 1d10 + Wis mod HP.

features.name: Rot and Violence
features.description: While transformed, gain additional benefits.

benefits.name: Menacing Aura
benefits.description: Creatures failing Unnerving Aura save can't regain HP or take Reactions until start of your next turn.

benefits.name: Strangling Roots
benefits.description: When hitting with a weapon, you can activate Sap or Slow in addition to another mastery property.

features.name: Ancient Might
features.description: Suffused with ancient power.

benefits.name: Ominous Strikes
benefits.description: Hits against Frightened creatures deal extra damage equal to Wis mod.

benefits.name: Persistent Wrath
benefits.refresh: Long Rest or Level 4+ spell slot
benefits.description: If reduced to 0 HP while transformed, drop to 2x Ranger level HP instead.

benefits.name: Timeless
benefits.description: Immunity to the Exhaustion condition.

features.name: Hunter
features.description: Hunters stalk prey in the wilds, using their abilities to protect nature and people from forces that would destroy them.

features.name: Hunter's Lore
features.description: While a creature is marked by your Hunter's Mark, you know its Immunities, Resistances, and Vulnerabilities.

features.name: Hunter's Prey
features.description: Choose one option, changeable after a Short or Long Rest.

options.name: Colossus Slayer
options.description: Once per turn, deal extra 1d8 damage on a weapon hit if the target is missing any HP.

options.name: Horde Breaker
options.description: Once per turn, after a weapon attack, make another attack against a different creature within 5ft of original target.

features.name: Defensive Tactics
features.description: Choose one option, changeable after a Short or Long Rest.

options.name: Escape the Horde
options.description: Opportunity Attacks have Disadvantage against you.

options.name: Multiattack Defense
options.description: When a creature hits you, they have Disadvantage on all other attacks against you this turn.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Prey
features.description: Once per turn, when dealing Hunter's Mark damage, deal that extra damage to a different creature you can see within 30ft of the first.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
features.description: When you take damage, use a Reaction to gain Resistance to that damage type until the end of the turn.

features.name: Arcane Trickster
features.description: Arcane Tricksters enhance their roguish skills with arcane magic, using illusions and enchantments to aid their thefts and pranks.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Intelligence is your spellcasting ability. You use an Arcane Focus. You know Mage Hand and other Wizard cantrips. Prepare Wizard spells from the Arcane Trickster table.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
features.description: Cast Mage Hand as a Bonus Action. It's Invisible. Use a Bonus Action to control it, including making Sleight of Hand checks.

features.name: Magical Ambush
features.description: If you are Invisible when casting a spell, the target has Disadvantage on the save.

features.name: Versatile Trickster
features.description: When you use the Trip Cunning Strike, you can also apply it to a creature within 5ft of your Mage Hand.

features.name: Spell Thief
features.description: Use a Reaction after being targeted by a spell to force an Int save. Fail: negate the spell's effect on you and you 'steal' it (have it prepared for 8 hours; they can't cast it).

features.name: Assassin
features.description: Assassins master the art of death, utilizing stealth, poison, and lethal ambushes to eliminate targets with cold efficiency.

features.name: Assassinate
features.description: Advantage on Initiative rolls. In the first round of combat, gain Advantage on attacks against creatures that haven't acted yet. Sneak Attack deals extra damage equal to your Rogue level.

benefits.name: Initiative
benefits.description: Advantage on Initiative rolls.

benefits.name: Surprising Strikes
benefits.description: First round: Advantage vs those who haven't acted; +Rogue Level damage to Sneak Attack.

features.name: Assassin's Tools
features.description: Gain proficiency with Disguide Kit and Poisoner's Kit.

features.name: Infiltration Expertise
features.description: Master techniques for infiltration.

benefits.name: Masterful Mimicry
benefits.description: Mimic speech/handwriting after 1 hour of study.

benefits.name: Roving Aim
benefits.description: Steady Aim no longer reduces your Speed to 0.

features.name: Envenom Weapons
features.description: When using Poison Cunning Strike, target takes extra 2d6 Poison damage on a failed save (ignores Resistance).

features.name: Death Strike
features.description: On first round Sneak Attack, target makes Con save or attack damage is doubled.

features.name: Phantom
features.description: Phantoms walk the line between life and death, infusing strikes with necrotic energy and claiming tokens from the departed.

features.name: Wails from the Grave
features.description: After dealing Sneak Attack damage, target a second creature within 30ft to take Necrotic damage equal to half your Sneak Attack dice.

features.name: Whispers of the Dead
features.description: After a rest, gain one skill or tool proficiency you lack. Replaces previous choice.

features.name: Tokens of the Departed
features.description: Gain soul trinkets (max 2; increases at L13 and L17) when creatures die within 30ft. Provides multiple benefits.

benefits.name: Death's Knell
benefits.description: Destroy trinket to use Wails from the Grave without expending a use.

benefits.name: Life Essence
benefits.description: Advantage on Death saves and Con saves while holding a trinket.

benefits.name: Spirit Query
benefits.description: Destroy trinket to cast Augury (Con based) or ask the spirit one question.

features.name: Voice of Death
features.description: Cast Speak with Dead once per rest (Dexterity based). Can target a soul trinket instead of a corpse.

features.name: Ghost Walk
features.description: Take spectral form: 10ft Fly Speed (hover), Hazy Form (attackers have Disadvantage), and Incorporeal Movement (move through objects, 1d10 force damage if inside at end of turn).

features.name: Death's Friend
features.description: Wails from the Grave damage hits both targets. Gain a soul trinket on Initiative if you have none.

features.name: Soulknife
features.description: Soulknives strike with the mind, manifesting shimmering blades of psychic energy to cut through physical and psychic barriers.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.description: Harbor Psionic Energy Dice to fuel powers. Regain 1 die on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest.

benefits.name: Psi-Bolstered Knack
benefits.description: Add die to a failed proficient skill/tool check. Only spend if it causes success.

benefits.name: Psychic Whispers
benefits.description: Telepathic link with PB creatures within sight (1 mile range) for roll hours.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.description: Manifest simple melee blades (1d6 Psychic, Finesse, Thrown 60/120, Vex mastery) for attacks. Bonus Action for a second attack (1d4 damage).

features.name: Soul Blades
features.description: Psychic Blade improvements.

benefits.name: Homing Strikes
benefits.description: Add die to missed Psychic Blade attack roll. Only spend if it causes a hit.

benefits.name: Psychic Teleportation
benefits.description: Throw blade and teleport 10x roll feet.

features.name: Psychic Veil
features.description: Become Invisible (ends on damage/save). Restore use by expending one Psionic Energy Die.

features.name: Rend Mind
features.description: On Sneak Attack hit, force Wisdom save or target is Stunned for 1 minute (repeat save at end of turns). Restore use by expending 3 Psionic Energy Dice.

features.name: Thief
features.description: The quintessential adventurer, Thieves excel at agility, stealth, and maximizing the use of magic items found in ruins.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.description: As a Bonus Action, make a Sleight of Hand check (locks, traps, pickpocket) or take the Utilize/Magic action to use an object/magic item.

features.name: Second Story Work
features.description: Gain Climb Speed equal to your Speed and use Dexterity for jump distance.

features.name: Supreme Sneak
features.description: Gain a Cunning Strike option.

options.name: Stealth Attack
options.description: Stay Invisible (from Hide action) if you end turn in 3/4 or Total Cover.

features.name: Use Magic Device
features.description: Improve magic item usage.

benefits.name: Attunement
benefits.description: Attune to up to 4 magic items.

benefits.name: Charges
benefits.description: On a 1d6 roll of 6, use a charge-expending property for free.

benefits.name: Scrolls
benefits.description: Use any Spell Scroll (Int based). Reliable casting for L0-1; DC 10+level Arcana check for L2+.

features.name: Thief's Reflexes
features.description: Take two turns during the first round of combat (Initiative and Initiative - 10).

features.name: Aberrant Sorcery
features.description: An alien influence has wrapped its tendrils around your mind, giving you psionic power to touch other minds and alter reality.

features.name: Telepathic Speech
features.description: Form a telepathic link with a creature within 30ft. Communicate if within Cha mod miles. Link ends if you connect with another.

features.name: Psionic Sorcery
features.description: Cast Psionic Spells using Sorcery Points (cost = level). Spells cast this way require no components (except costly/consumed Materials).

features.name: Psychic Defenses
features.description: Gain Resistance to Psychic damage and Advantage on saves vs Charmed/Frightened.

features.name: Revelation in Flesh
features.description: Spend Sorcery Points to gain transformations:

options.name: Aquatic Adaptation
options.description: 2x Speed Swim Speed, breathe underwater.

options.name: Glistening Flight
options.description: Fly Speed equal to Speed (hover).

options.name: See the Invisible
options.description: See invisible creatures within 60ft (not behind Total Cover).

options.name: Wormlike Movement
options.description: Move through 1-inch spaces; spend 5ft to escape nonmagical restraints/Grappled.

features.name: Warping Implosion
features.description: Teleport 120ft. Creatures within 30ft of the departure point make a Str save or take 3d10 Force damage and are pulled toward the spot.

features.name: Clockwork Sorcery
features.description: Channel cosmic forces of order from Mechanus, equalizing chaotic moments and shielding others with shimmering fields of law.

features.name: Restore Balance
features.description: Use a Reaction to prevent a creature within 60ft from being affected by Advantage or Disadvantage on a d20 roll.

features.name: Bastion of Law
features.description: Create a ward (d8s = SP spent) around a creature within 30ft. Spend dice to reduce damage by the amount rolled. Lasts until Long Rest.

features.name: Trance of Order
features.description: Attackers can't have Advantage against you. Treat d20 rolls of 9 or lower as 10.

features.name: Clockwork Cavalcade
features.description: Summon spirits in a 30ft Cube: heal 100 HP (divided as you choose), repair objects, and dispel level 6 or lower spells.

features.name: Draconic Sorcery
features.description: Breathe the magic of dragons, manifesting scales, wings, and elemental affinities inherited from draconic ancestors.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.description: HP maximum increases by Level. While not wearing armor, AC = 10 + Dexterity + Charisma.

features.name: Elemental Affinity
features.description: Gain Resistance to the chosen type. Add Charisma modifier to one damage roll of spells of that type.

features.name: Dragon Wings
features.description: Sprout wings for a 60ft Fly Speed.

features.name: Dragon Companion
features.description: Cast Summon Dragon for free once per Long Rest (no components). Can cast without Concentration (1 min duration).

features.name: Shadow Sorcery
features.description: Shadow sorcerers command darkness, undeath, and woe, drawing magic from the Shadowfell to bend doom and darkness to their will.

features.name: Power of Shadow
features.description: Harness shadow magic.

benefits.name: Eyes of the Dark
benefits.description: 120ft Darkvision, 10ft Blindsight. See through your own Darkness spells.

benefits.name: Strength of the Grave
benefits.description: When reduced to 0 HP, make a Charisma save to drop to (Charisma mod + level) HP instead.

features.name: Beasts of Ill Omen
features.description: Cast Summon Beast for free as a shadow beast. Enemies within 5ft of it have Disadvantage on saves vs your spells. Can cast without Concentration (1 min duration).

features.name: Shadow Walk
features.description: Teleport up to 120ft between areas of Dim Light or Darkness.

features.name: Umbral Form
features.description: While Innate Sorcery is active, move through objects (Difficult Terrain; 1d10 force damage if inside) and gain Resistance to all damage except Force and Radiant.

features.name: Wild Magic Sorcery
features.description: Wild magic sorcerers unleash untamed chaos, where every spell has the potential to trigger a reality-warping surge of magic.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.description: After casting a spell slot spell, roll 1d20. On a 20, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table.

rows.result: Roll on this table at the start of each of your turns for the next minute.
Summon a friendly creature (1 min): 1: Duodrone, 2: Flumph, 3: Monodrone, 4: Unicorn.
Regain 5 HP at start of each turn for 1 minute.
Creatures have Disadvantage on saves vs your next spell within 1 minute.
Roll 1d8 for a 1 min effect: 1: Ethereal music, 2: Size increase, 3: Feather beard, 4: Shouting, 5: Butterflies, 6: Forehead eye (Adv on Perception), 7: Pink bubbles, 8: Blue skin (24h).
Action spells become Bonus Action spells for 1 minute.
Transported to Astral Plane until end of next turn.
Maximize damage dice for the next spell within 1 minute.
Resistance to all damage for 1 minute.
Turn into a potted plant (Incapacitated, Vulnerable) until next turn.
Teleport 20ft as a Bonus Action each turn for 1 minute.
You and 3 creatures within 30ft become Invisible (1 min; ends on atk/cast).
Spectral shield (+2 AC, Magic Missile immunity) for 1 minute.
Take one extra action this turn.

Cast random spell (no concentration): 1: Confusion, 2: Fireball, 3: Fog Cloud, 4: Fly (random), 5: Grease, 6: Levitate (self), 7: Magic Missile (L5), 8: Mirror Image, 9: Polymorph (self/Goat), 10: See Invisibility.
Nonmagical objects you touch ignite (1d4 fire) for 1 minute.
If you die within the hour, revive as if by Reincarnate.
Frightened until end of next turn.
Teleport 60ft.
Random creature within 60ft is Poisoned for 1d4 hours.
Radiate light (30ft); creatures ending turn within 5ft are Blinded (1 turn) for 1 minute.
Up to 3 creatures within 30ft take 1d10 Necrotic; you heal the total.
Up to 3 creatures within 30ft take 4d10 Lightning.
You and all within 30ft have Vulnerability to Piercing for 1 minute.
Roll 1d6: 1: Heal 2d10, 2: Ally heals 2d10, 3: Regain lowest slot, 4: Ally regains lowest slot, 5: Regain all Sorcery Points, 6: All row 17-20 effects.

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.refresh: Spell slot cast or Long Rest
features.description: Gain Advantage on a D20 Test. After using, cast a spell slot spell to regain use and automatically trigger a Wild Magic Surge.

features.name: Bend Luck
features.description: Add or subtract 1d4 from another creature's D20 Test total.

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.description: Roll twice on the Wild Magic Surge table and pick either result.

features.name: Tamed Surge
features.description: After casting a spell slot spell, choose any effect from the Wild Magic Surge table (except last row) instead of rolling.

features.name: Archfey Patron
features.description: Your pact draws on the power of the Feywild, making you an agent of inscrutable and whimsical archfey.

features.name: Steps of the Fey
features.description: Cast Misty Step without a slot (uses = Cha mod). When you cast it (with or without a slot), choose an effect:

options.name: Refreshing Step
options.description: You or an ally within 10ft of your destination gains 1d10 Temp HP.

options.name: Taunting Step
options.description: Creatures within 5ft of your departure point make a Wis save or have Disadvantage on attacks against others until next turn.

features.name: Misty Escape
features.description: Cast Misty Step as a Reaction to taking damage. Gain two new Steps of the Fey options:

options.name: Disappearing Step
options.description: Become Invisible until start of next turn (or until atk/cast/damage).

options.name: Dreadful Step
options.description: Creatures within 5ft of your departure or arrival point make a Wis save or take 2d10 Psychic damage.

features.name: Beguiling Defenses
features.refresh: Long Rest or expend Pact slot
features.description: Immune to Charmed. When hit by an attack, use a Reaction to halve the damage and force the attacker to make a Wis save. Fail: they take Psychic damage equal to what you took.

features.name: Bewitching Magic
features.description: After casting an Enchantment or Illusion spell (1 action, spell slot), cast Misty Step as part of the same action without a slot.

features.name: Celestial Patron
features.description: Your pact draws on the Upper Planes, the realms of everlasting bliss, allowing you to experience the holy light that illuminates the multiverse.

features.name: Healing Light
features.description: Expend a pool of d6s to heal yourself or an ally within 60ft. Max d6s per use = Charisma modifier.

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.description: Gain Resistance to Radiant damage. Once per turn, add Charisma modifier to Radiant or Fire spell damage against one target.

features.name: Celestial Resilience
features.description: When you use Magical Cunning or finish a rest, gain Temp HP = Level + Cha mod. Up to 5 allies gain Temp HP = half Level + Cha mod.

features.name: Searing Vengeance
features.description: When you or an ally within 60ft makes a Death Save, use a Reaction to heal them (half HP maximum). Nearby enemies take 2d8 + Cha mod Radiant damage and are Blinded for 1 turn.

features.name: Fiend Patron
features.description: Your pact draws on the Lower Planes, the realms of perdition, defined by your struggle against or alignment with your patron's evil aims.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.description: When you or someone within 10ft reduces an enemy to 0 HP, you gain Temp HP = Charisma mod + Warlock level.

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck
features.description: Add 1d10 to an ability check or saving throw after rolling.

features.name: Fiendish Resilience
features.description: Choose one damage type (except Force) to gain Resistance to until you choose again.

features.name: Hurl Through Hell
features.refresh: Long Rest or expend Pact slot
features.description: Once per turn on a hit, target makes a Charisma save or is transported to hell until your next turn (Incapacitated; 8d10 Psychic damage if not a Fiend).

features.name: Great Old One Patron
features.description: Bind yourself to an unspeakable being from the Far Realm or an elder god, drawing strange magic from incomprehensible motives.

features.name: Awakened Mind
features.description: Form a telepathic link with a creature within 30ft. Communicate if within Cha mod miles. Link ends if you connect with another.

features.name: Psychic Spells
features.description: Change Warlock spell damage type to Psychic. Enchantment/Illusion spells require no Verbal or Somatic components.

features.name: Clairvoyant Combatant
features.refresh: Short/Long Rest or expend Pact slot
features.description: When using Awakened Mind, force a Wisdom save. Fail: target has Disadvantage vs you, and you have Advantage vs target for the bond duration.

features.name: Eldritch Hex
features.description: Always have Hex prepared. Targets of your Hex have Disadvantage on saves of the chosen ability.

features.name: Thought Shield
features.description: Thoughts cannot be read telepathically. Gain Resistance to Psychic damage; attackers take Psychic damage equal to what they deal to you.

features.name: Create Thrall
features.description: Modify Summon Aberration: no Concentration (1 min duration); gain Temp HP (Level + Cha mod). Aberration deals extra Psychic damage to your Hex target.

features.name: Undead Patron
features.description: You've made a pact with a creature that defies the cycle of life and death, granting you command over necrotic energy and the ability to transform into a fearful avatar.

features.name: Form of Dread
features.description: Transform for 1 minute: gain 1d10 + Level Temp HP; immune to Frightened; once per turn on hit, force Wis save or target is Frightened until your next turn.

features.name: Grave Touched
features.description: Your necrotic damage ignores Resistance. Once per turn, change damage type of a spell to Necrotic. In Form of Dread, add one extra damage die to Necrotic damage (once/turn). You don't need to sleep, eat, drink, or breathe.

benefits.name: Arcane Necrosis
benefits.description: Necrotic damage ignores Resistance. Can change spell damage to Necrotic once/turn.

benefits.name: Dreaded Necrosis
benefits.description: In Form of Dread, +1 damage die to Necrotic damage (once/turn).

benefits.name: Undead Endurance
benefits.description: No exhaustion from dehydration/malnutrition/suffocation; no sleep required.

features.name: Necrotic Husk
features.description: Gain Resistance to Necrotic (Immunity in Form of Dread). When reduced to 0 HP, explode (30ft, Con save vs 2d10 + Cha mod Necrotic), drop to 2x Level HP instead, and gain 1 level of Exhaustion.

features.name: Superior Dread
features.description: In Form of Dread: Resistance to Bludgeoning/Piercing/Slashing; 60ft Fly Speed (hover); move through objects (1d10 force if ending inside); cast Conjuration/Necromancy spells without components (unless costly/consumed).

features.name: Abjurer
features.description: Abjurers focus on spells that block, banish, or protect, creating powerful arcane wards to shield themselves and their companions.

features.name: Abjuration Savant
features.description: Add two level 1-2 Abjuration spells to your spellbook. Add another for free whenever you gain access to a new spell level.

features.name: Arcane Ward
features.description: Cast an Abjuration spell with a slot to create a ward (HP = 2x Level + Int mod). Regain ward HP (= 2x slot level) by casting Abjuration spells or using a Bonus Action to spend a slot.

features.name: Projected Ward
features.description: When a creature within 30ft takes damage, use a Reaction to have your Arcane Ward absorb it.

features.name: Spell Breaker
features.description: Always have Counterspell and Dispel Magic prepared. Cast Dispel Magic as a Bonus Action (+PB to check). Slot isn't spent if either spell fails to stop a spell.

features.name: Spell Resistance
features.description: Advantage on saving throws against spells and Resistance to spell damage.

features.name: Diviner
features.description: Diviners strive to part the veils of space, time, and consciousness, mastering spells of discernment, foresight, and supernatural knowledge.

features.name: Divination Savant
features.description: Add two level 1-2 Divination spells to your spellbook. Add another for free whenever you gain access to a new spell level.

features.name: Portent
features.description: Roll two d20s (three at L14) after a Long Rest. Replace any D20 Test you see with one of these rolls before the roll occurs (once per turn).

features.name: Expert Divination
features.description: When you cast a level 2+ Divination spell, regain an expended slot of a lower level (max 5th).

features.name: The Third Eye
features.description: Choose one until next rest: 120ft Darkvision, Read all languages, or cast See Invisibility without a slot.

features.name: Evoker
features.description: Evokers specialize in magic that creates powerful elemental effects, acting as arcane artillery or protectors with explosive power.

features.name: Evocation Savant
features.description: Add two level 1-2 Evocation spells to your spellbook. Add another for free whenever you gain access to a new spell level.

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.description: When you miss or a target saves against your damaging cantrip, it takes half damage (if any) but no additional effects.

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.description: When casting an Evocation spell, choose creatures up to 1 + spell level to automatically succeed on their saves and take no damage.

features.name: Empowered Evocation
features.description: Add Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of any Wizard Evocation spell.

features.name: Overchannel
features.description: Deal maximum damage with a Wizard spell (L1-5). First use is free; subsequent uses before a Long Rest deal 2d12 Necrotic per spell level (increases by 1d12 each time).

features.name: Illusionist
features.description: Illusionists dazzle the senses and trick the mind, weaving subtle spells of deception that can even manifest as semi-real objects.

features.name: Illusion Savant
features.description: Add two level 1-2 Illusion spells to your spellbook. Add another for free whenever you gain access to a new spell level.

features.name: Improved Illusions
features.description: Cast Illusion spells without Verbal components. Increase range by 60ft if 10ft+. Learn Minor Illusion (or another cantrip); can create sound and image together as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Phantasmal Creatures
features.description: Always have Summon Beast and Summon Fey prepared. Change school to Illusion (spectral form). Cast each once per Long Rest without a slot (halved HP).

features.name: Illusory Self
features.description: Use a Reaction to interpose a duplicate and make an attack automatically miss. Restore use with a level 2+ spell slot.

features.name: Illusory Reality
features.description: When casting an Illusion spell slot, use a Bonus Action to make one inanimate, nonmagical object in the illusion real for 1 minute (can't deal damage/conditions).

features.name: Alchemist
features.description: Alchemists are experts at combining reagents to produce magical effects, using potions to give life or to leech it away.

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.description: Gain proficiency with Alchemist's Supplies and Herbalism Kit. Halve the time required to brew potions.

features.name: Experimental Elixir
features.action: Bonus Action (to drink), Magic Action (to create extra)
features.description: Create elixirs at end of Long Rest (2 at L3, 3 at L5, 4 at L9, 5 at L15). Roll for effects. Spend a slot to create one with a chosen effect.

rows.name: Healing
rows.result: Regain HP = 2d8 + Int mod (+1d8 at L9 and L15).

rows.name: Swiftness
rows.result: Speed increases by 10ft (+5ft at L9 and L15) for 1 hour.

rows.name: Resilience
rows.result: +1 AC for 10 min (1h at L9, 8h at L15).

rows.name: Boldness
rows.result: Add 1d4 to attack rolls and saves for 1 min (10 min at L9, 1h at L15).

rows.name: Flight
rows.result: Fly Speed = 10ft (+10ft at L9 and L15) for 10 min.

rows.name: Choice
rows.result: Choose any of the other effects.

features.name: Alchemical Savant
features.description: Add Intelligence modifier to one roll of a spell that restores HP or deals Acid, Fire, or Poison damage.

features.name: Restorative Reagents
features.description: Cast Lesser Restoration for free using Alchemist's Supplies focus.

features.name: Chemical Mastery
features.description: Mastery of chemical magic.

benefits.name: Alchemical Eruption
benefits.description: Once per turn when a spell deals Acid/Fire/Poison damage, deal an extra 2d8 Force damage.

benefits.name: Chemical Resistance
benefits.description: Resistance to Acid and Poison; Immunity to Poisoned condition.

benefits.name: Conjured Cauldron
benefits.description: Cast Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron once per Long Rest without a slot or components.

features.name: Armorer
features.description: Armorers treat armor as a second skin, modifying it to suit frontline combat or stealthy infiltration.

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.description: Gain proficiency with Heavy armor and Smith's Tools. Halve armor crafting time.

features.name: Arcane Armor
features.description: Turn worn armor into Arcane Armor: no Strength requirement, Utilize action to don/doff, can't be removed, and serves as a focus.

features.name: Armor Model
features.description: Choose a model (Dreadnaught, Guardian, or Infiltrator) for your Arcane Armor. Use Int for attacks with model weapons.

options.name: Dreadnaught
options.description: Force Demolisher (1d10 Force, Reach, push/pull 10ft). Giant Stature (Bonus Action: become Large, +5ft Reach; uses = Int mod).

options.name: Guardian
options.description: Thunder Pulse (1d8 Thunder, Disadvantage vs others). Defensive Field (Bonus Action: Temp HP = Level if Bloodied).

options.name: Infiltrator
options.description: Lightning Launcher (90/300ft, 1d6 Lightning + 1d6 once/turn). +5ft Speed and Advantage on Stealth.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice per Attack action.
