features.name: Improved Armorer
features.description: Learn one extra Armor category infusion and can have one extra Armor infusion active. Special weapons gain +1 to attack/damage.

features.name: Perfected Armor
features.description: Armor models improve.

benefits.name: Dreadnaught
benefits.description: Demolisher becomes 2d6. Giant Stature can make you Huge, +10ft Reach, and Advantage on Str checks/saves.

benefits.name: Guardian
benefits.description: Pulse becomes 1d10. Use a Reaction to pull a creature within 30ft toward you (25ft); if within 5ft, make a melee attack.

benefits.name: Infiltrator
benefits.description: Launcher becomes 2d6. Hits grant Advantage on next attack and Disadvantage for target vs you. Gain Fly Speed = 2x Speed as a Bonus Action (uses = Int mod).

features.name: Artillerist
features.description: Artillerists specialize in hurling energy and explosions, manifesting tactical cannons on the battlefield.

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.description: Gain proficiency with Martial Ranged weapons and Woodcarver's Tools. Halve wand crafting time.

features.name: Eldritch Cannon
features.refresh: Long Rest or expend spell slot
features.description: Create a Small/Tiny cannon (AC 18, HP = 5x Level). Activate as a Bonus Action within 60ft. Choose type:

options.name: Flamethrower
options.description: 15ft cone, 2d8 Fire damage (half on success).

options.name: Force Ballista
options.description: 120ft ranged spell attack, 2d8 Force damage and push target 5ft.

options.name: Protector
options.description: Grant 1d8 + Int mod Temp HP to creatures within 10ft.

features.name: Arcane Firearm
features.description: Turn a wand/staff/rod/ranged weapon into a focus that adds 1d8 to one damage roll of an Artificer spell.

features.name: Explosive Cannon
features.description: Cannon damage/healing increases by 1d8. Use a Reaction to detonate for 3d10 Force damage in a 20ft radius (Dex save for half).

features.name: Fortified Position
features.description: Have two cannons at once (create/activate with same actions). You and allies have Half Cover within 10ft of a cannon.

features.name: Battle Smith
features.description: Battle Smiths are protectors and medics, accompanied by a Steel Defender companion of their own creation.

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.description: Gain proficiency with Smith's Tools. Halve weapon crafting time.

features.name: Battle Ready
features.description: Gain proficiency with Martial weapons. Use Intelligence for magic weapon attack/damage rolls. Use a proficient weapon as a focus.

features.name: Steel Defender
features.refresh: Long Rest or expend spell slot
features.description: Summon a Medium Construct (AC 12+Int, HP 5 + 5xLevel). It takes its turn on yours (Bonus Action to command; or replaces one of your attacks for Force-Empowered Rend). It has a Repair action (3/Day) and a Deflect Attack reaction.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice per Attack action. Can replace one attack to command Steel Defender to use Force-Empowered Rend.

features.name: Arcane Jolt
features.description: When you or your defender hit with a magic weapon/rend, once per turn deal +2d6 Force damage or heal 2d6 HP to a creature within 30ft.

features.name: Improved Defender
features.description: Arcane Jolt increases to 4d6. Attackers hit by defender's Deflect Attack take 1d4 + Int mod Force damage.

features.name: Cartographer
features.description: Cartographers are premier navigators and reconnaissance agents, using magical maps to highlight threats and safeguard allies.

features.name: Tools of the Trade
features.description: Gain proficiency with Calligrapher's Supplies and Cartographer's Tools. Halve scroll crafting time.

features.name: Adventurer's Atlas
features.description: Create magical maps for yourself and allies. Map holders gain +1d4 to Initiative and can target each other regardless of sight/cover if within range.

benefits.name: Awareness
benefits.description: Add 1d4 to Initiative rolls.

benefits.name: Positioning
benefits.description: Know the location of all other map holders on the same plane. Target map holders regardless of sight or cover if within range.

features.name: Mapping Magic
features.description: Magical mapping benefits.

benefits.name: Illuminated Cartography
benefits.description: Cast Faerie Fire for free.

benefits.name: Portal Jump
benefits.description: Spend half your Speed to teleport 10ft, or 5ft from a map holder within 30ft.

features.name: Guided Precision
features.description: Once per turn, add Intelligence modifier to damage of Cartographer spells or attacks against Faerie Fire targets. Damage doesn't break Concentration on Faerie Fire.

features.name: Ingenious Movement
features.description: When using Flash of Genius, you or the target can teleport up to 30ft as part of the Reaction.

features.name: Superior Atlas
features.description: Atlas improvements.

benefits.name: Safe Haven
benefits.description: When a map holder drops to 0 HP, they can destroy the map to drop to 2x Level HP and teleport within 5ft of you or another holder.

benefits.name: Unerring Path
benefits.description: Cast Find the Path for free once per Long Rest (requires holding a map).

features.name: Reanimator
features.description: Reanimators stitch together servants from corpses and transform necromancy into a terrifying science.

features.name: Reanimator's Skill Set
features.description: Gain proficiency with Alchemist's Supplies. Modify Spare the Dying to heal (Level HP) and deal Lightning damage (2d4 + scaling) in a 10ft emanation (uses = Int mod).

benefits.name: Jolt to Life
benefits.description: Spare the Dying revives target with HP = level; 10ft emanation Dex save or 2d4 (up to 4d4) Lightning damage.

features.name: Reanimated Companion
features.refresh: Long Rest or expend spell slot
features.description: Summon a Medium Undead (AC 10+Int, HP 5 + 5xLevel). It has Death Burst (2d6 Necrotic on death) and Lightning Absorption actions. Use a Bonus Action to command (or replace an attack for Dreadful Swipe).

actions.name: Dreadful Swipe
actions.description: 1d4 + Int mod Necrotic; target can't take Opportunity Attacks.

traits.name: Death Burst
traits.description: 10ft Emanation on death, Dex save or 2d6 (4d4 at L9) Necrotic damage.

traits.name: Lightning Absorption
traits.description: Heal equal to Lightning damage taken.

features.name: Strange Modifications
features.description: Companion gains one (later more) modification:

options.name: Arcane Conduit
options.description: Cast spells from companion space. +Int to Evocation/Necromancy damage once/turn.

options.name: Ferocity
options.description: Dreadful Swipe die becomes 1d6.

options.name: Bloated (L9+)
options.description: Large size. Swipe pushes 10ft. Death Burst +Int damage.

options.name: Gaunt (L9+)
options.description: 45ft Speed/Climb. 10ft aura: Wis save or Frightened.

options.name: Moist (L9+)
options.description: Swim Speed. Move through 1-inch spaces. Attackers within 10ft take Acid damage = Int mod.

features.name: Improved Reanimation
features.description: Companion's Death Burst becomes 4d4. Its Necrotic damage ignores Resistance. Gain two Modifications.

features.name: Refined Reanimation
features.description: Mastery of science.

benefits.name: Facilitated Revival
benefits.description: Cast Raise Dead for free once per Long Rest.

benefits.name: Life Transfer
benefits.description: Take a Reaction when you/companion take damage to heal HP = companion's current HP; companion dies.

benefits.name: Superior Modifications
benefits.description: Companion gains three Modifications.
